nom: PEACH & LILY Transparen-C Pro Spot Treatment

avis.texte: I bought this product because the consultant said it would fade dark spots. Nothing happened and it wasn't cheap. I returned it.

avis.titre: Took a break from it, back again!
avis.texte: I love this product! I stopped buying it to try other products and just bought a bottle again. Still love it, it will be an always product for me again.
This stuff is almost like a dry oil . . love it for dark spots
This is a really great quality Vitamin c serum and the packaging is so beautiful and luxe. Works great and looks great!!

I did not realize when I purchased this product it would be so greasy. I've also been using consistently and still haven't seen any results. I would recommend just using a good vitamin c cream instead. I wanted to love it, but unfortunately, I would not purchase again.

I can't speak to any noticeable differences in my skin quite yet as I've only been using the product for a couple of weeks. One thing of note it is rather sticky and takes a lot to cover areas of concern on my face, neck and chest. I realize it says spot treatment so I put it in the palm of my hand and Pat, but still it takes a lot to have the effect to cover in order to get any sort of good results. I'm going to stick with it and see what happens so far it's fine nothing magnificent. We'll see how things work out down the road

I bought this one along with the Super Fade, alternating between the two products to tackle stubborn decade old dark spots. Love the texture and the design and the bottle is glass not plastic. To fade dark spots completely takes time so it still is too early to say but I like how it has worked so far.
This product is the only thing that has ever faded my dark spots quickly within 2-3 weeks. Cannot recommend enough!!
The applicator works great. I just started using the product so too early to tell if it works as promised . The treatment goes on nicely..not greasy or oily

My skin type is dry, sensitive, and acne prone. I've tried pure vitamin C and that burned my skin. Since this is an oil based derivative, I thought I'd give it a try! I tried using it as a face serum and that was a bit too intense and caused some acne. I mixed a few drops with my moisturizer every other day and my skin seems to handle that. Unfortunately my skin is a bit too sensitive so I might go for a lower percentage vitamin next time.

This serum which I use daily, has the consistency of an oil IMHO. It feels amazing on my skin and works well with Peach & Lily's Famous Glass Skin Serum. Sometimes during the summer Transparen-C serum is so moisturizing enough that a moisturizer isn't even necessary after using this serum or oil- imho.

I absolutely adore this. It makes my skin so bright and happy. It hydrates without feeling like it's too thick and heavy. It also helps any acne scars and leaves a nice little glow without looking greasy.

avis.titre: A must have, Always in my Routine
avis.texte: This is a must have IMHO. I also feel like it's more of an oil than a serum, so it's quite moisturizing. Sometimes in the summer I don't even need a moisturizer, I just skip ahead to a moisturizing SPF. transparen-C not only has a high level of vitamin C in it but has Ferulic Acid, Tranexamic acid and Vitamin E to boost brightening effects.

Very happy with my results so far with this product. I deal with hyperpigmentation due to acne/blemishes especially if I pick at them ( a terrible habit I am well aware). I picked this up due to my go to brand being discontinued and I am quite happy with my results so far, though product texture and feel isn't what i was expecting. This is very oily so I was concerned about having more breakouts but none so far. I have noticed a difference in my complexion and that my "spots" have lightened up quite a bit.

avis.titre: This is the best Vit C se
avis.texte: This is the best Vit C serum I have tried! It's potent and yet gentle! I saw brighter, more even-toned skin in DAYS! Dark spots a thing of the past. Highly recommend. A little goes a long way.
I had some dark spots on my cheeks and this has lightened them already just like it advertised! It also makes my skin shin so beautifully!

This really, really dealt with some pigmentation under my right eye that nothing else was working on. Just for transparency (haha) the type of dark spots I've been dealing with are pregnancy melasma. I can't speak to how this product would work on long-standing sun damage or other types of dark spots. That being said, I saw significant improvement within 2 weeks of using it to the degree that I wish I'd taken before and after photos. It was very easy to incorporate into my routine because I just layered it under the glass skin serum. I love the formula, the fact that it has such high percentages of such great ingredients, and how quickly it sinks in despite what feels like a very oily texture at first. I highly recommend this if you need a Vitamin C in your routine.
Great quality oil. Feels very smooth and brightening after use.

I love this vitamin c spot treatment. I had to restock on it. It's great if you have dry skin. The quality is good. I wish it was in a bigger bottle. I did not receive any marks on my face when using this treatment. I believe it's great for scar prevention.
Does amazing things for my skin, and it looks and feels incredible!

This is my single favorite skincare product. I've been using it for 3+ years now & tell anyone who will listen how well it has worked for me. This product makes me GLOWY, looking smooth and hydrated! I have always had troubled skin; persistent severe acne (for 15+ years), uneven skintone & dark spots, dermatitis- the whole gamut- and this product has made a noticeable difference in the appearance of my skin. One time I thought I would take a break from it to save a little coin and oh my god- my skin looked so dull in comparison soon after my bottle ended 😭 shocking the difference! Let me tell you I RAN back to ulta. It is worth the money! It applies like a thick soft oil, it is smooth and layers well with other products. I dont know what I will do if peach & lily ever discontinues this honestly, so buy it please ;)

I really wanted to like this, but after weeks of consistent use, I realized it caused breakouts. I took a break from using, & when I started up again, I got pimples only in the areas I used this product on. I wouldn't recommend for acne prone skin.

I am admittedly a skincare junkie- not necessarily a good thing, but I've learned along the way by being prey to marketing campaigns and spending (dare I say wasting) money on products that only impacted my bank account. All that said, this is one of the few products I repurchase constantly. I get a strange anxiety that I will run out because it has made a noticeable difference in my pigmentation and it just makes my skin glow. It plays well with sunscreen and makeup and I cannot recommend highly enough. I now am very diligent to try only one product at a time to make sure it's making an impact and so I know what is working. This works.

I really really love this product because of its brightening effect as well as how it minimizes the appearance of my fine lines and acne scars. It's been so helpful because I have a lot of acne marks from before.

This serum might be a little too heavy for humid/hot months—it clogs my pores—but I find that it works well for the rest of the seasons. I've tried other Vitamin C serums and nothing comes close to this skincare formula!! My holy grail. I've seen results in as little as 1 week. I apply this every morning, followed by moisturizer & sunscreen.

This is my first vitamin C product ever and I'm impressed ! It's a bit greasy, but the effect is soooo worth it. My skin is glowing, luminous, and my pimples scars are disappearing way faster. Definitely will repurchase !

avis.titre: Doesn't diminish dark spots, very oily
avis.texte: I used this for months and saw no difference in dark spots. What a waste of money. Plus it feels and smells like old cooking oil. If I'm going to use an oil it could at least smell nice.
Got this to lighten my freckles. I hope it works. Don't see much of a difference yet. Fingers crossed. Seems to be lighting them a little after a week .

Im so obsessed with his product. I breakout once or twice a month with one or two HUGE cystic pimples, when they're finally healing, I turn to this stuff and have noticed an almost completely clear complexion since I first started using this product almost nightly, about two months ago. I truly hope this product is always on the shelf!

I have been using this awhile. I am still undecided as to how much of an effect it is having on my dark spots. I only use a drop on my face and place it directly onto my dark spots and then pat it in to the rest of the face. I think the spots may be lightening but they are certainly not disappearing.

avis.titre: The most effective dark spot lightener
avis.texte: I've tried many brightening treatments to remove acne or mosquito bite scars but few have been as effective as this one. The price point may deter some, but there are genuine results here.
It's oily, leaves the skin shiny and at the same time acts against blemishes, the dispenser is very good.
The Transparen-C Pro Spot Treatment lasts all day and provides a great non greasy glow to my skin making my face appear younger than my age. I love this and have purchased it several times.

This product has helped me so much! I've seen a different in just two weeks. I use it along with the peach and Lily face wash and my skin has never looked better! I've started to get so many compliments on my skin! I'll continue to buy more of their products and test them out!

I use this every morning and mix a few drops into my glass skin serum or moisturizer and it truly works! If I get a breakout I'll use it as a spot treatment and it does a fabulous job of lightening any hyperpigmentation or dark spot! Amazing.

I have dry flaky skin and struggle with hormonal ance. I ahve been usikg this product for 2years it is my ritual!! Ever dark spot GONE, even old ones from years ago. A little goes a long way . Pat 1-2 drops into skin focusing on dark spots , DONT RUB IN

I wanted to like this product because I love the copper peptide serum and lactic acid serum. However this Vitamin C serum is way too oily and has broken my skin out. At 64 years old I feel like I shouldn't get breakouts at this age.
I've been dealing with bad chin acne, dark spots and texture. This cleared it up in about 3 weeks!
My skin is really sensitive and this product has changed my live, my face look different and bright, so good this serum, I would buy it again
I love this product, I can tell the dark spots are fading on my forehead. I will buy this again
I regret wasting so much money on this. Used for 2.5 months and did absolutely nothing, zero zilch nada. Spots never changed. I actually see new spots. Dont be deceived by the hype
Good news: it lessons darkspots Bad news: causes tiny breakouts Recommendation: only apply where needed. May still develop a tiny tiny pimple there but atleast it'll be lighter.

I use this product to tackle my really stubborn dark spots. The ones that I've had for several years (since I was a teenager) have become significantly lighter, and with continued use, they are becoming even more lighter.

I don't love this vitamin-c serum, but I also use it all over my face when it should be more of a spot treatment. It's pretty sticky and has a smell to it, but it is definitely hydrating. I am 55 and have a lot of dark spots that skincare probably can't fix unfortunately. It is well-sized and has lasted me a long time.

avis.titre: It's working but it takes a while
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle, trying to fade multiple scars from surgery. They are getting lighter slowly but surely. The product is a little greasy and can drip down once applied. If it was in cream form or a little more viscous, it would help. Overall, I like the product and will continue with it.

avis.titre: Used for month seen some reduction in color
avis.texte: I've been using this on sunspots for a month ans seen some reduction in the discoloration, but nothing dramatic.
Great at lightening dark spots. Thanks for giving hope! I really like the applicator too!
This is the only product I use that actually lightens my dark spots. My scars clear up within a few weeks. The design of the bottle is the perfect applicator.
I put this on right before I use the Glass Skin Serum. It really brightens my sensitive skin!
I love pairing this with the glass skin serum in the morning. It is so brightening!

I've started seeing results after 2 weeks of daily use. My dark spots have noticeably improved. My husband even commented on my complexion being more even toned! This spot treatment is great quality and a little goes a long way! My skin is glowing! Highly recommended it!!

avis.titre: I  had to return it, it really affected my skin so badly tha
avis.texte: Being such a natural product, is made with too many plant and flowers oils that one of them affected my skin the same way as poison ivy or sumac. Had to be treated with steroids. My suggestion if you don't know if you are allergic to any plant oil, be careful

I have been using this product for just over 2 weeks every night before bed. My sunspots/freckles are fading already and I really like the overall look and feel of my skin's texture. My spouse confirmed seeing a difference as well. Happy so far!

At 30, I still regular get acne. My sensitive, fair skin also tends to hold on to hyperpigmentation after a pimple has dried up and vanished. I've tried many products to fade these spots. I used this spot treatment (kind of all over my face since there are so many dark spots) morning and night for six months. I never felt any irritation from it. It didn't noticeably or miraculously fade my dark spots, though, which has been a real shame. I would even really massage it into the spots, but it never seemed to accelerate the clearing. Honestly not sure if this product was the thing to help fade the spots, or if they just did naturally, as they slowly tend to do from my normal daily skincare routine. Time to try something else, yet again.

I actually love combining this with the rosehip oil every morning before my workouts! The combination has been perfect for me. I woke up with a tiny blemish and by noon it was gone! It's brightened my skin as well as diminished my scars and dark spots
Just started this product and I can see the difference already.
Been using the spot treatment for almost a month. I noticed the dark spots are getting lighter. Feels a little oily at first, but after using the skin care with it, it all blends in fine.

Not sure if I applied too much or needed to gradually add to my skincare routine. I developed skin irritation on my cheeks & neck - last for a week. My skin is red & dry. Will try again once I recover. Any suggestions on use of product in future

Great serum. I mix it with the glass refining serum and can really see an improvement with dark spots. i had stopped using it, trying to pare down the number of items i use, but had to reintroduce this to my routine. Would def recommend!

This is my first time using this product. I have tried several other vitamin C products from different companies, but I didn't see much effect. Plus, my skin got irritated by those products, making the applied areas red. I decided to give this transparent-C Pro spot treatment a try. This project is very gentle and doesn't irritate my skin. After using it for about two weeks, my dark spots have lightened, and my skin tone in general, has become more even. I have finally found the right product.
Amazing peach and lily have some of my favorite products as far as Vitamin C for the face this is my go to no burning feel nice consistency and applies super easy!

I was looking for a product to reduce my dark undereyes. This product definitely helped lighten my undereyed. I've ran out of this product and haven't been using it as of late. I'm like scraping the bottom to get every last drop and put it on my under eyes lol. Overall, I 100% have noticed a difference while using this product. the only thing thats holding me back is the prive point. i hope i can find a dupe for this if not I'll just resport back to this product.
I just received this a few weeks ago so u haven't seen much for results yet. It has a nice texture though and feels good on my face.

avis.titre: Great product, can be harsh on sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is a great vitamin C product. I use it once a week as it can be irritating to my sensitive skin, but not nearly as irritating as other vitamin C / antioxidant products. Love all things Peach and Lily!

I started using this about a year ago to help with my dark spots / acne scars and I haven't looked back. Give it about a month, to see results. I will say it's a little oily but it works well with the transparen-c cream for dark spots
I have been using this for a few weeks now and my skin is so glowy. I'll come back with more Folsom review once I finish the bottle but I love this brand
I really like this serum! It is smooth and hydrating, and I use it twice a day. It is too early to tell how well it treats spots, but I plan to repurchase because of the skin-healthy ingredients.

This gives me such a noticeable glow and revives my skin in the morning, especially when I'm tired and haven't had enough sleep. I have recommended this to many of my friends. I've tried the Paula's Choice vitamin C before and did not like the stronger fragrance there and noticed less of a glow than I get with this one from Peach and Lily. One bottle lasts a fairly long time as well, almost a full year for me. I have sensitive skin and have never had an issue with this serum despite it being a 20% concentration.
This evened my complexion and is reducing the appearance of scars and dark spots. It has enhanced my routine.
The transparen-c poopoo has served me well for years. Works great for discolorations and overall hydration.
Been using this for years. It really works to minimize the dark spots on my face.
So far so good! Love how it applies and makes my skin look very glassy.

First off, I love the packaging and the little dropper. I have been using this along with Glassy Skin Serum AND Red Light Therapy for about a month now and I am already noticing my dark spots starting to fade. Instead of using this as a spot treatment, I use this all over just like a serum (I have a lot of dark spots LOL) and I very much love the feel of this product. It's very moisturizing which is great this time of year!

avis.titre: I would definitely try this again and again
avis.texte: Well, it's been about 2 weeks and I see improvement already! It feels great on my skin.I love it! 😊

My Go Tooooo !!! I cant live without this product .This product has removed dark spots that i thought would never disappear. . Gentle enough for my extremely dry skin (soberrheric dermatitis). Any dark dpot gone with two weeks when applied to the area daily. One bottle lasted me a year as i only use it to treat dark spots . Ladies GET IT

My Go Tooooo !!! I cant live without this product .This product has removed dark spots that i thought would never disappear. . Gentle enough for my extremely dry skin (soberrheric dermatitis). Any dark dpot gone with two weeks when applied to the area daily. One bottle lasted me a year as i only use it to treat dark spots . Ladies GET IT

I'm on my second bottle of the Vitamin C Spot Serum. I've seen a noticeable change in my dark spots on my face and on the back of my hands. I'm an older lady who spent too much time in the sun when I was younger. I have a few dark spots on my face & back of my hands. I use this serum twice a day and after three to four months of use, I can tell the spots are fading. I will continue to use this product. The serum is oily, but disappears into my skin and does not break my face out. I would recommend this as I have all the Peach & Lily products that I have tried so far.

I use this product every morning. I use it all over my face as opposed to a spot treatment. I run out quickly this way but it is worth it to me, it gives me a glow no matter how rough my skin is looking.
Feels so good on my skin. A bit oily feeling, but absorbs really well and has faded discoloration on my skin. Love

avis.titre: Wish it worked better for me
avis.texte: It has only helped my acne spots a little, which was disappointing. I also wish the serum was a little thinner since it feels more like an oil. But, it has given my skin a lovely glow since I've been using it all over my face recently.
Really work!!! Love this product. Changes the skin tone and dark spots
I've been using this for a couple of weeks now and LOVE it. It came highly recommended from a skin care professional I deeply respect and it's already earned a prominent spot in my AM routine.
This is the best vitamin C treatment I've ever used. It goes in so nicely and feels wonderful. I can definitely see results from using it. I highly recommend it. Great product!
My skin has never look so bright and healthy It gives my face a natural glow.. it's light weight and sinks quickly into my skin. Another winner
I love this product. I am already seeing a difference in the brightness of my skin. Would definitely recommend this product if you want to even out your skin tone.
I tried Transparen C to replace a custom 20% Vit C product I had used for years. Excellent results. Even better than my old expensive serum. Plus it's not yellow. I'll be a loyal user for sure.
My face is lighter, brighter, and well-moisturized. I'm a huge fan already!
Great product! I've seen the difference in such a short period of using it
This is exactly what you need to even out those dark spots. This treatment is the gift that keeps on giving!!
Disappointing. I didn't realize this was an oil. It dried my skin out and did nothing for my pigmentation.

avis.titre: Sits on skin, can't wear under makeup
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this, but I do not. I want to use it in the morning, since I do a texture or retinol serum at night. I do not like the oil base - it just feels like it sits on the skin. Makeup readily pills over it. I will use it since I have it, but would not repurchase.
This is the BEST Vit C I ever used. Really works! Is great for dark scars. I love it!
Been using this transparente-c for many years now It is amazing. Hydrates, softens and glows :+1::skin-tone-2::+1::skin-tone-2::+1::skin-tone-2:

avis.titre: Use it for everything is the best :hearts:️
avis.texte: I've been using this for over a year , I get a lot of pigmentation for sun exposure I also get freckles in the same spot and they sometimes look like a big dark spot, this has been my salvation, in the beginning it tingles a bit but you get used to it, and the results are hydrated, small pores, glass looking face, also it's the best for expression lines or fine lines, to summarize it's good for everything even calming your skin texture if you break out when there is a lot of dust:heart:️
My second bottle of a moisturizer that fades imperfections. Love this!
I love this serum! It has helped even out my skin! I even ventured out and bought some new makeup! I have never felt more confident about my skin! Thank you!

I started using this on January. I'd apply it 2x a week at night. At first I didn't see a big difference until I took a before and after. I'm so happy with the improvement.😊 Will continue to use till bottle runs out and maybe in the future.

I love this my dark spots start to lighten up for only 3 weeks and I already order my second bottle :relaxed:️ very happy with this purchase and the delivery is faster than expected I really recommend this to people like me that have dark spots for years now maybe this transparent-c pro spot treatment for you you too:u1F970:
Great vitamin C serum. Very hydrating and I've already noticed a difference in my dark spots:)) in just 2 weeks.

I only gave this 4 stars right now as I have just started using it. It is my understanding it takes about 3 weeks for the dark spots to begin to fade. So far I am happy with this product and how it gets absorbed quickly.

This vitamin C serum has actually helped to reduce my dark spots. The change is gradual, but it's certainly noticeable after the first two weeks. I like that it is coupled with vitamin E oil, and I was initially worried that this might irritate my skin, but I find that even though the serum is contains this oil it provides more light moisture to my skin than anything.

I cant say enough about this C treatment. I know it sounds crazy but I can see a small improvement on my face. The "age" spots look a little lighter after just 10 days. I can't wait to see the results after a few months!

Have not used long enough to see results but I like the texture, the scent, and my skin has been able to tolerate the formula if I use it every other day. Eventually, if I decide to repurchase it, I know I'll be able to use it on a daily basis.

Been using a week so I cannot comment on the dark spot improvement. My issue is the serum is very oily and seems to just sit my skin. I use it sparingly. I may give up on this unless I see some fading of of the dark spots.

Gross, but honest - I may or may not nervously pick any imperfections/ pimples when they come in, even knowing that is damaging. The Transparen C helps my skin repair and works on the marks that leaves behind. I like to use in my AM routine after the Lazy day all in one and before glass skin to hydrate under my makeup.

I LOVE IT. The consistency is wonderful. It feels very moisturizing on its own which is great. I follow with an oil serum to lock in moisture. I haven't been using it quite long enough to see about dark spot impacts, but definitely have noticed a difference in my texture since incorporating the product.
